package.json.name: Package manifest
package.json.description: Declares the Node 22 and pnpm 10 engines, every pnpm script the gates and generators run, and the Next, Fumadocs and script dependencies.

pnpm-workspace.yaml.name: pnpm install rules
pnpm-workspace.yaml.description: Allowlists dependency build scripts, enforces a 7-day minimum release age, overrides ws and katex for advisories and lists ignored GHSAs.

prettier.config.ts.name: Prettier config
prettier.config.ts.description: Extends the Offchain Labs shared config, registers the import-sort plugin for code files and keeps MDX unwrapped at a 9999 print width.

svgo.config.ts.name: SVGO config
svgo.config.ts.description: Tunes preset-default for brand diagrams: keeps viewBox, ids, title and desc, and rounds path data to 2 decimals.

tsconfig.json.name: TypeScript config
tsconfig.json.description: Strict bundler-resolution config with erasableSyntaxOnly and .ts imports so Node 22 runs scripts directly; maps @/ and collections/ paths.
